程序包 com.destroystokyo.paper.profile

接口 PlayerProfile

public interface PlayerProfile
Represents a players profile for the game, such as UUID, Name, and textures. 表示玩家的游戏档案，例如 UUID、名称和材质。

    • complete

      default boolean complete()
      If this profile is not complete, then make the API call to complete it. This is a blocking operation and should be done asynchronously. 如果此档案不完整，则发起 API 调用来补全它。这是一个阻塞操作，应在异步线程中进行。 This will also complete textures. If you do not want to load textures, use {complete(boolean)} 这也会补全材质。如果你不想加载材质，请使用 {complete(boolean)}
      返回:
      If the profile is now complete (has UUID and Name) (if you get rate limited, this operation may fail) 该档案现在是否完整（拥有 UUID 和名称）（若你受到速率限制，此操作可能失败）

    • complete

      boolean complete(boolean textures)
      If this profile is not complete, then make the API call to complete it. This is a blocking operation and should be done asynchronously. 如果此档案不完整，则发起 API 调用来补全它。这是一个阻塞操作，应在异步线程中进行。 Optionally will also fill textures. 可选地也会填充材质。 Online mode will be automatically determined 联机模式将被自动确定
      参数:
      textures - controls if we should fill the profile with texture properties 控制是否应用材质属性填充该档案
      返回:
      If the profile is now complete (has UUID and Name) (if you get rate limited, this operation may fail) 该档案现在是否完整（拥有 UUID 和名称）（若你受到速率限制，此操作可能失败）

    • complete

      boolean complete(boolean textures, boolean onlineMode)
      If this profile is not complete, then make the API call to complete it. This is a blocking operation and should be done asynchronously. 如果此档案不完整，则发起 API 调用来补全它。这是一个阻塞操作，应在异步线程中进行。 Optionally will also fill textures. 可选地也会填充材质。
      参数:
      textures - controls if we should fill the profile with texture properties 控制是否应用材质属性填充该档案
      onlineMode - Treat this server as online mode or not 是否将此服务器视为联机模式
      返回:
      If the profile is now complete (has UUID and Name) (if you get rate limited, this operation may fail) 该档案现在是否完整（拥有 UUID 和名称）（若你受到速率限制，此操作可能失败）
